title: BanAppeal (nezboy11 #2 attempt)

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

First off, I notice you are ban evading on another account at this very moment. Ban evading on another account only lowers your chances of being appealed. 

Secondly, if an appeal of yours was denied only 2 days ago, there is a very small chance that it will be appealed in such a short time. 

This appeal is denied. Please don't ban evade in the future, either. 

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator
